authorization: Decision 0007; exactly three disclosed peer allowances, lifecycle scripts disabled. No repository applications, global upgrades, charts, servers/browser/device execution or final-pin adoption.
normalization: Temporary roots in retained UTF-8 text normalized to $LINT_PROBE_ROOT, $PROBE_ROOT, $LINT_RESEARCH_ROOT and $LINT_MAP_ROOT. Hashes/lengths identify original bytes. Installed dependency implementation/binaries and caches are omitted except selected reviewed source/notice text. Synthetic inputs, reports, lock, config, commands and fetched registry records retained.

files.text:
import hashlib,json
from run import R,NODE,PNPM,run
WS=R/'workspace'
rows=[]
for app in ['web','admin']:
 cwd=WS/app
 lint=run(app+'-clean-lint-recheck',[str(NODE),str(WS/'node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js'),'app','src','probe-settings.js','--max-warnings','0','--format','json','--output-file',str(R/'evidence'/f'{app}-clean-diagnostics.json')],cwd,300)
 if lint['exit_code']!=0:raise SystemExit('Stop: full-config clean lint failed in '+app)
 data=json.loads((R/'evidence'/f'{app}-clean-diagnostics.json').read_text());assert len(data)==7 and all(not x['messages'] for x in data)
 typ=run(app+'-typecheck',[str(NODE),str(WS/'node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc'),'--project','tsconfig.json','--noEmit','--pretty','false'],cwd,300)
 if typ['exit_code']!=0:raise SystemExit('Stop: clean type-check failed in '+app)
 rows.append({'app':app,'lintedFiles':len(data),'messages':0,'typecheckExit':typ['exit_code']})
before=hashlib.sha256((WS/'pnpm-lock.yaml').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
r=run('repeat-frozen-install',[str(PNPM),'--state-dir',str(R/'cache/pnpm/state'),'install','--frozen-lockfile','--ignore-scripts'],WS,300)
assert r['exit_code']==0 and hashlib.sha256((WS/'pnpm-lock.yaml').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==before
(R/'evidence/clean-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps({'apps':rows,'frozenRepeat':True,'lockSha256':before},indent=2)+'\n')
